title: A Summer to Come Up for Air

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Summer.
For Uma Musume, it's a season of showdowns.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
How much I ran this summer. How hard I studied my rivals.
Whether I poured my spirit and stamina into it — honing myself without a sliver of compromise.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
——I'm going to see it through. Victory only lies beyond that point!
And yet... even so——

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: …………whoaaa.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Display the event title logo.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Summer.
For Uma Musume, it's——

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
A super fun season! Oh my god, it's finally hereee!
Like, there's no option but to get hyped here, y'know?!!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
So that's why I invited Ai-chan, and we're gonna play summer to the fullest!
Weee☆

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Ai seems kinda busy-ish, no?
Then I'll just hit her up later.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Phew, phew... alright!
One more lap of long-distance swimming...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
So here, y=3/4... done! Math prep is finished!
Next up is... Japanese. .............

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
29... 30! ...hah, hah... oh, it's already this late?
I have to get in before the baths close!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: …………isn't this kinda bad?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
All day today, the whooole time!
You never once gave me an opening to talk to youuu!?

text_block_list.name: Ai & Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaahhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Hah, hah, hah... ahaha.
Yes! I beat Kiseki-chan again! Yesss!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Hah, hah... ughhh! I see, the gap is still this big... damn it!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Alright then — one more!
I'm going to keep going, but what about you, Kiseki-chan?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hahh... I'm in, me too! Of course!
Until I land one on you, as many times as it takes!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Hehe, thank you! I was hoping to run with lots of different people at this training camp! Keep counting on me, Kiseki-cha——

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Heyyy!! Enough is enoughhh!!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I've been watching you, Ai-chan!
You're trying way, way too hard! I'm worried about you!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I get that you wanna push yourself at summer camp!
But nothing but training is bad, y'know?! Your body!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
So... right? You know?
Won't you come play with mee♡

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Um, Pandora-san. I appreciate the thought, but...
I'm sorry. I can't do that.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Whaaaaaaan!
I'm straight-up pien-ing out!? What's the deal, Ai-chan!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, you're overdoing it! Isn't that bad?
It's summer! You should take it a little easier...!

text_block_list.name: Bright & Sky
text_block_list.text:
Whoaa...
Fwaaaah...

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Right, so it's like this... wait, huh? Actually, there's some super laid-back seniors here. Wow. Whatcha up to?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Oh, Pandora-sama. Good day.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
What, can't you tell?
We're taking a lunch break. Whoaa.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Oh, is that so? ...It's already 3 PM, though?
Ahah, you're just slacking off.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
...Actually, yeah. Right? It's summer, after all?
Slacking off matters too, doesn't it!!?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, hey, seniors. There's a girl I'd like to teach a thing or two about that. Could you help me out?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Right? Together? Okay?♡ Kind seniors can't say no to a cute underclassman's request, can they? Pout, pout, pout...☆

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Huh... a match...? Y-yes, of course!
I couldn't ask for anything more!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh, you're up for it? Then, can the two of you come with me?

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
A match against Sky-senpai...! It's a mock race, right?
Ughhhhh! Now I'm fired up!!

text_block_list.name: Fishing Tournament Staff
text_block_list.text:
Late registration, got it! Yes, you're signed up!
The tournament starts the day after tomorrow at 10 AM! Have fun!

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? A tournament? We were all gonna do a mock race...
Wait, huh? That's not what this was about...?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Huh, no? Aren't you misunderstanding something?
What we're doing is——

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: A fishing tournament☆ Yay.

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ehhhhhhh!? F-Fishing tournament?!!!
